row_key: product_id = release:event; never combine both releases for an overlapping event

fields.stats: df/dtau/spin/mass_detector/redshift: N, mean, median, std_ddof1, quantiles_05_16_50_84_95, sigma_q90, sigma_q68, min, max
fields.predictions: 10 readings; delta_tau null if local observable not defined; all_exact_QNM_control_delta_tau for 8 applicable readings
fields.snr_existing_metadata: list of previously archived metadata; conventions deliberately separate, may be empty
fields.source_sha256: raw HDF5 bytes freshly hashed before and after selected fields read

null_semantics: OPEN/no unique observable; never zero or numerical success
